kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
انعزلت (form VII)
# اِنْعَزَلْتُ (inʕazaltu) /in.ʕa.zal.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِنْعَزَلَ (inʕazala)
# اِنْعَزَلْتَ (inʕazalta) /in.ʕa.zal.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِنْعَزَلَ (inʕazala)
# اِنْعَزَلْتِ (inʕazalti) /in.ʕa.zal.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِنْعَزَلَ (inʕazala)
# اِنْعَزَلَتْ (inʕazalat) /in.ʕa.za.lat/: third-person
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
